scope: Equity Uprise shared World presentation support; SELECT-only catalog inspection; no personal rows
query: select now() as checked_at, current_setting('server_version') as postgres_version, to_regclass('public.eup_world_display')::text as display_table, to_regprocedure('public.eup_world_display_read()')::text as display_read, to_regprocedure('public.eup_world_display_set(uuid,boolean)')::text as display_set, (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table_name',table_name,'column_name',column_name,'data_type',data_type,'is_nullable',is_nullable) order by table_name,ordinal_position) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and ((table_name='orgs' and column_name in ('id','slug')) or (table_name='org_members' and column_name in ('org_id','profile_id','role')))) as prerequisites;
